highlights: AI agents are maturing with unified architectures for orchestration and self-evolving capabilities, complemented by new API tools enabling robust production deployments for developers.

Major AI developers like OpenAI and Google are pushing model efficiency and accessibility, with GPT-5.6 offering better price-performance and new features extending into critical sectors like healthcare.

The industry is intensifying its focus on AI safety and evaluation, with new benchmarks and frameworks emerging to scrutinize agent performance, reasoning, and ethical deployment in real-world, high-stakes environments.

agents.title: OpenClaw and Ollama in Agentic AI: Toward Fully Autonomous and Scalable AI Agent Systems
agents.summary: This paper introduces a layered architecture for Agentic AI, integrating Ollama for LLM inference and OpenClaw for agent runtime orchestration, demonstrating emergent capabilities like persistent memory and tool use from system-level integration. It provides a unified architectural foundation for building scalable, secure, and trustworthy autonomous AI agents.

agents.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
agents.summary: SciToolAgent-Evo is an ontology-aware, self-evolving agent designed for open-world scientific tool acquisition, distilling knowledge from contrastive trajectories and dynamically integrating new tools. This enables highly flexible and adaptive scientific automation by autonomously expanding tool utilization.

agents.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
agents.summary: Google announced new capabilities for Managed Agents in the Gemini API, including support for Gemini 3.6 Flash and advanced hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents. These enhancements facilitate building complex agent workflows with greater control and efficiency.

models.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
models.summary: OpenAI announced lower pricing for GPT-5.6 (Luna and Terra versions) combined with increased efficiency, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible and cost-effective for enterprise deployment and large-scale AI workflows.

models.title: ThinkReset: Learnable Intermediate Interface Construction for Bounded-Context Long-Horizon Reasoning
models.summary: ThinkReset improves LLM long-horizon reasoning by explicitly constructing reusable intermediate interfaces, effectively combating redundancy accumulation, context overflow, and error anchoring. This approach consistently enhances success rates for complex, multi-step problems under fixed context windows.

models.title: New research shows how AMIE, our medical AI, could help manage health conditions.
models.summary: New research published in 'Nature' demonstrates that Google's conversational AI system, AMIE, can match primary care physicians in managing complex diseases, highlighting its significant potential for accurate and robust clinical decision support in healthcare.

tools.title: Native-speed vLLM transformers modeling backend
tools.summary: This announcement details a native-speed vLLM transformers modeling backend, promising significant performance boosts for running transformer models. This is critical for developers building low-latency and high-throughput AI applications.

tools.title: TAPR: Enhancing LLM Performance with a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter
tools.summary: TAPR (Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter) is an RL-trained model that automatically reformulates user prompts into task-optimized versions, leading to consistent performance gains for downstream LLMs on diverse tasks. This tool makes advanced LLMs more accessible and effective for non-expert users.

tools.title: An Ontology-Guided, Deduplication-Aware Extraction Layer for Knowledge Graph Construction from Heterogeneous Documents
tools.summary: This paper presents a production-ready extraction layer for knowledge graph construction, utilizing an ontology-guided LLM for entity and relationship extraction and a refinement pipeline with deduplication. It addresses LLM inconsistencies and improves data quality from diverse documents for robust KG creation.

companies.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
companies.summary: OpenAI announced achieving ten breakthroughs on long-standing open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, including advances in geometry, cryptography, and complexity. This highlights OpenAI's deep research capabilities and commitment to fundamental scientific progress.

companies.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI launched 'Health in ChatGPT' for eligible U.S. users, allowing secure connection of medical records and Apple Health data for personalized health insights. This marks a significant expansion of ChatGPT's capabilities into the regulated healthcare sector.

companies.title: Safety, or Just Capability? A Validity Audit of Agent-Safety Benchmarks
companies.summary: A critical audit of agent-safety benchmarks reveals significant inconsistencies, small-panel artifacts, and a negative correlation between model capability and misalignment safety. This study urges greater specificity in safety claims for AI agents and highlights the need for robust evaluation methodologies.

learning.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
learning.summary: OpenAI is granting free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to 100,000 academic researchers, aiming to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery. This initiative democratizes access to frontier AI for the scientific community.

learning.title: Univé builds an AI-ready workforce
learning.summary: Univé successfully transformed its workforce into an 'AI-ready' one using ChatGPT Enterprise, showcasing a blueprint for combining leadership, responsible governance, and employee-led innovation to integrate AI at scale. This provides a valuable case study for enterprise AI adoption.

learning.title: New York City educators and industry leaders gathered at Google’s offices to shape the future of AI in classrooms.
learning.summary: Google, in collaboration with the New York Jobs CEO Council and Urban Assembly, hosted an AI summit for educators and industry leaders to shape the integration of AI into classrooms and workforce development programs. This initiative fosters AI education and talent preparation.
